test_policy.notes: Brown requires SAT or ACT for first-year applicants (policy in place since the 2024-25 cycle); superscored, no minimum score. SAT Essay/ACT Writing and ACT Science optional.

requirements.notes: Four Brown essays required on the 2026-27 Common App (more for PLME and the Brown-RISD dual degree). Two teacher recommendations from major academic subjects; at least one math/science teacher for B.S. or PLME. Automatic fee waivers for FRPL-eligible students. Interview and CSS Profile requirements not confirmed on pages checked.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Deadline 11:59 p.m. applicant's local time; decision by mid-December (no exact date published).

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Deadline 11:59 p.m. applicant's local time; decision by early April (no exact date published); reply by May 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Highly recommended for international applicants for whom English is not a first language, a primary language at home, or the primary language of instruction for all of secondary school. Brown does not accept MyBest scores.

english.notes: Expected in most cases for exams taken before January 2026.
Expected in most cases for exams taken January 2026 or later.
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency; minimum expected in most cases.

aid.notes: Need-blind for international students beginning with the Class of 2029; meets full demonstrated need for admitted students who apply for aid at the time of application. No merit awards.

tier_notes.business: No business school; the Business, Entrepreneurship & Organizations concentration is the closest option.
tier_notes.pre_med: Strong pre-med outcomes; the PLME 8-year program links to Warren Alpert Medical School.
tier_notes.humanities: Top-10 humanities with an open curriculum.
tier_notes.arts_design: Strong arts; Brown-RISD dual-degree program available (very selective).
